description: Figure 8(c) is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating the metric labeled “Branching Ratio γB” across different numbers of few-shot examples (shots). The horizontal axis contains the categories “Number of Shots,” shown as discrete integer groups (0, 1, 2, 3, 4) arranged left to right, while the vertical axis is a numeric scale for the branching ratio (γB) on a linear scale (exact tick labels are small, but the axis spans from near 0 up to roughly around 1). Each shot category contains two adjacent bars: a blue bar labeled “Incorrect” and a red bar labeled “Correct,” as indicated by the legend above the plot. Visually, the red “Correct” bars are consistently taller than the blue “Incorrect” bars across all shot counts; the tallest red bar appears at 0 shots (near the top of the axis, around ~0.9–1.0), and the shortest blue bars occur at higher shot counts (around ~0.1–0.2). The bars are not shown as stacked, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or special emphasis beyond the color coding and the side-by-side grouping within each shot category.
